info.name: CodeBloggs Module 10 Backend
info.description:
## CodeBloggs Module 10 Backend Collection

This collection preserves the working Module 9 backend requests and adds the completed Module 10 backend requests.

### Local Setup
1. Start MongoDB access and the backend server.
2. Confirm the server is running at `{{base_url}}`. Default: `http://localhost:5050`.
3. Run setup requests in order when testing happy paths: Create User, Login, Create Post, Create Comment, Create Reply.
4. Use only throwaway records for destructive Module 10 delete requests.

### Variables
- `base_url`: backend base URL
- `user_id`: populated by Create User or manually set to a throwaway user id
- `post_id`: populated by Create Post or manually set to a throwaway post id
- `comment_id`: populated by Create Comment or manually set to a throwaway comment id
- `reply_id`: populated by Create Reply or manually set to a throwaway reply id

### Module 10 Requests
The `Module 10 Backend` folder contains happy-path, malformed-id, and nonexistent-id scenarios for all completed Module 10 backend endpoints.

variable.description: Base URL for the local CodeBloggs backend API.
MongoDB user _id. Create User can overwrite this for happy-path user tests.
MongoDB post _id. Create Post can overwrite this for happy-path post tests.
MongoDB comment _id. Create Comment can overwrite this for happy-path comment tests.
MongoDB reply _id. Create Reply can overwrite this for happy-path reply tests.

item.name: User
item.description: Module 9 user registration and retrieval requests. These are preserved for setup and regression testing.

request.description:
Endpoint: POST /user

Setup instructions:
No prior request required. Use a unique email each time if the database already has this user.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON user registration fields: first_name, last_name, email, password, birthday, optional location, optional occupation.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { user }, message: "Registration successful. Please log in." }

Expected error responses:
400 validation/missing fields, 409 duplicate email, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: GET /user

Setup instructions:
Optional: run Create User first so at least one user exists.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
None

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { users: [] }, message: "Users retrieved successfully" }

Expected error responses:
500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: GET /user/:id

Setup instructions:
Run Create User first or set user_id to an existing user.

Required variables:
- base_url
- user_id

Required headers:
None

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { user }, message: "User retrieved successfully" }

Expected error responses:
404 user not found or malformed id, 500 unexpected server error.

item.name: Session
item.description: Module 9 cookie-based authentication requests. Login sets the session_token cookie used by protected create/upload routes.

request.description:
Endpoint: POST /session

Setup instructions:
Run Create User first or use credentials for an existing user.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with email and password.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { user }, message: "Login successful" } and HTTP-only session_token cookie.

Expected error responses:
401 invalid email/password, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: GET /session/validate

Setup instructions:
Run Login first so Postman has a valid session_token cookie.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
Cookie: session_token is handled by Postman after Login.

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { user }, message: "Session is valid" }

Expected error responses:
401 unauthorized, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: DELETE /session

Setup instructions:
Optional: run Login first. This endpoint is idempotent.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
Cookie: session_token is handled by Postman after Login.

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: {}, message: "Logged out successfully" }

Expected error responses:
500 unexpected server error.

item.name: Presence
item.description: Module 9 presence request. Requires a valid session cookie.

request.description:
Endpoint: GET /presence

Setup instructions:
Run Login first. This request also refreshes the caller presence heartbeat.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
Cookie: session_token is handled by Postman after Login.

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { activeUserIds: [] }, message: "Presence retrieved successfully" }

Expected error responses:
401 unauthorized, 500 unexpected server error.

item.name: Posts
item.description: Module 9 post create/read/like requests. Module 10 delete requests live in Module 10 Backend.

request.description:
Endpoint: POST /posts

Setup instructions:
Run Login first. user_id is taken from the session cookie.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with content.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { post }, message: "Post created successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid post data, 401 unauthorized, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: GET /posts

Setup instructions:
Optional: run Create Post first so at least one post exists.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
None

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { posts: [] }, message: "Posts retrieved successfully" }

Expected error responses:
500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: PATCH /posts/:id

Setup instructions:
Run Create Post first or set post_id to an existing post.

Required variables:
- base_url
- post_id

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with likes increment, for example { "likes": 1 }.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { post }, message: "Post updated successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid post data, 404 post not found, 500 unexpected server error.

item.name: Comments
item.description: Module 9 comment create/read/update requests. Module 10 delete requests live in Module 10 Backend.

request.description:
Endpoint: POST /comments

Setup instructions:
Run Login and Create Post first. user_id is taken from session cookie.

Required variables:
- base_url
- post_id

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with post_id and content.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { comment }, message: "Comment added successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid comment data, 401 unauthorized, 404 post not found, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: GET /comments

Setup instructions:
Optional: run Create Comment first so at least one comment exists.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
None

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { comments: [] }, message: "Comments retrieved successfully" }

Expected error responses:
500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: PATCH /comments/:id

Setup instructions:
Run Create Comment first or set comment_id to an existing comment.

Required variables:
- base_url
- comment_id

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with content and/or likes increment.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { comment }, message: "Comment updated successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid comment data, 404 comment not found, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: POST /replies

Setup instructions:
Run Login, Create Post, and Create Comment first.

Required variables:
- base_url
- post_id
- comment_id

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with parent_id, parent_type, root_comment_id, post_id, content, and depth.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { reply }, message: "Reply added successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid reply data, 401 unauthorized, 404 parent not found, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: GET /replies?post_id=:post_id

Setup instructions:
Run Create Post first. Query parameter is optional in backend, but this request filters by post.

Required variables:
- base_url
- post_id

Required headers:
None

Required body:
None

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { replies: [] }, message: "Replies retrieved successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid post_id, 500 unexpected server error.

Endpoint: PUT /replies/:id

Setup instructions:
Run Create Reply first or set reply_id to an existing reply.

Required variables:
- base_url
- reply_id

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with likes increment.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { reply }, message: "Reply updated successfully" }

Expected error responses:
400 invalid reply data, 404 reply not found, 500 unexpected server error.

item.name: Profile Pic
item.description: Module 9 profile picture upload and fetch requests.

request.description:
Endpoint: POST /profile-pic

Setup instructions:
Run Login first, then choose a JPEG or PNG file in the form-data image field.

Required variables:
- base_url

Required headers:
multipart/form-data generated by Postman

Required body:
form-data file field named image.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: {}, message: "Profile picture uploaded successfully." }

Expected error responses:
400 missing/invalid/too-large image, 401 unauthorized, 500 unexpected server error.

formdata.description: Choose a local JPEG or PNG file before sending.

exec: pm.test('Message is Profile picture uploaded successfully.', () => {

Setup instructions:
Run Create User and Upload Profile Picture first, or set user_id to a user with a profile picture.

Required variables:
- base_url
- user_id

Required headers:
None

None

Expected success response:
Raw image binary with image Content-Type.

Expected error responses:
404 profile picture not found, 500 unexpected server error.

request.description:
Endpoint: PATCH /user/:id

Setup instructions:
Run Create User first or set user_id to a throwaway existing user. This request updates allowed user fields only.

Required variables:
- base_url
- user_id

Required headers:
Content-Type: application/json

Required body:
JSON with any allowed fields: first_name, last_name, birthday, email, password, status, location, occupation, auth_level. Non-empty password values are hashed. Empty/missing password does not overwrite existing password.

Expected success response:
{ status: "ok", data: { user }, message: "User updated successfully" } and user does not include password.

Expected error responses:
400 invalid user id or validation error, 404 user not found, 409 duplicate email, 500 unexpected server error.
